今日もクリスマスパーティーに向けて、泉花達とクララの歌の練習。\n今はその休憩中:
Today, we were helping Kurara practice her singing for the Christmas party again.
We were taking a break with Senka and the others...
改めてすごいよな、曲まで作っちゃうなんて。: I'm still impressed that you even wrote the song.
初心者用作曲ツール使いつつ、内容も最低限に絞ってるもの。\n聞いてる側がそれっぽ:
I used a beginner's composition tool and kept it as simple as possible.
I put all my effort into making something that sounds the part, even if it's mostly a facade.
だから本場のプロのようなこだわりや濃さ、深みなんてゼロ。\n言うまでもないけど、:
So it has none of a professional's care, richness or depth.
Needless to say, it's nowhere near the real thing.
それでも歌詞は自分でゼロから考えたんだろ。: Still, you wrote the lyrics yourself from scratch, right?
泉花が歌ってるところを聞きたい: I'd like to hear you sing, Senka.
ええ、なんとなく浮かんだキーワードを並べただけだけど。: Yes, though I just strung together some words that came to mind.
ああ、泉花の歌も聞いてみたいなって。\nこの曲歌って見せてよ。:
Yeah, I'd like to hear you sing too, Senka.
Sing this song for me.
な、なんか恥ずかしいし……ヤダ。\nクララさんが歌ってくれるんだから十分でしょ？:
I-it's embarrassing... No.
Isn't it enough that Kurara-san's singing it?
俺は泉花のを聞きたいんだが……: But I want to hear you sing, Senka...
あー……もう。少しだけよ、たとえ下手くそでも笑わないでよ？: Ah... Honestly. Just a little, then. Don't laugh, even if I'm terrible, okay?
一生懸命歌った人の歌を、誰が笑うもんか。: Why would I laugh at someone who's doing their best to sing?
そう言うと、泉花はサビのあたりを歌ってくれたのだった。: With that, Senka sang a little of the chorus for me.
（恥ずかしいのかちょっと震えてるけど、\n透き通っていて綺麗な声だな……）:
(Her voice is trembling a little, maybe from embarrassment,
but it's so clear and beautiful...)
もしかして参考にした元ネタの曲とかあるのか？\n前に、ＣＭか何かで聞いた曲に似て:
Did you use another song as a reference?
It reminds me of something I heard in a commercial or something.
そりゃいくつかの既存作品を参考にしてるわ。ゼロから創れるほど、\nクリエイティブ:
Of course I used a few existing songs as references.
I'm not creative enough to make something completely from scratch.
失礼ね……『参考にした』の。\nでも基本創作ってこんな感じじゃないかしら……？:
How rude... I 'used them as references.'
Besides, isn't that basically how creating things works...?
今、世にあふれる作品はほとんど、複数の過去作品の要素を言語化\nしつつ分解して、:
Most of the work out there takes elements from several older works,
puts them into words, breaks them down and rebuilds them in different combinations.
本当のゼロから創られた作品なんて、\nそれこそ人類史の最初期まで遡らないと存在し:
For something truly created from nothing,
you'd have to go back to the earliest days of human history.
まあ、それとは別に私みたいな素人からすれば、既存作品を\n参考にするのが一番思っ:
But aside from that, for an amateur like me, using existing work as a reference
is the easiest way to make something close to what I have in mind.
